title: AWS AppSync to Amazon SQS
description: Create an AppSync GraphQl API that sends messages to an SQS queue

introBox.headline: How it works
text: The CDK template creates an AppSync API with an Amazon SQS as HTTP data source. An SQS queue is created, along with an IAM role that provides the AppSync API permission to send messages to that specific queue. Using the sendMessage query, you can add a message to the queue.
